signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story ranch house frontage across a lawn, partly shaded by a large tree.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Trimmed round shrubs line the foundation, but this is typical of homeowner upkeep and there is no crew-level evidence.

signals.notes: The front lawn is patchy and thin with bare dirt and dry spots, while the gray-blue siding and trimmed foundation shrubs look well kept; an SUV is parked by the garage and a white vinyl fence sits at the right side of the house.
